subject: Reconnecting after Inference & Ops Summit — next steps / pilot recap
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@fluxai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Great meeting at Inference & Ops Summit — quick next steps

Hi Samira / Tom —

It was great to meet you both briefly at the Inference & Ops Summit yesterday. Thanks again for the quick chat about Flux AI's latency hotspots on batch scoring and the need to reduce per-token serving cost for embeddings-heavy pipelines.

I promised to follow up with a short recap and a few concrete next steps so we can decide whether a short pilot makes sense. High level notes from our chat: 
- Goal: cut inference cost by ~35% for nightly scoring and keep p95 latency < 200ms for online features.
- Current infra: GPU VMs with mixed model versions; inconsistent KV cache usage.
- Compliance: SOC2 + tighter audit log retention coming Q3.

Suggested next steps from our side:
1) Quick 30–45m discovery call this week to review token profiles and a sample trace.
2) Redwood will run a free 7-day small-scale pilot (Dedicated trial) with a profiler run and cost projection.
3) Put together a one-page mutual action plan after the call with timelines.

I attached our one-pager deck from the booth and a short checklist for the pilot. Can you share 2 windows that work for a call? My Calendly: https://calendly.com/neha/fluxai-discovery

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-inference-deck.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira@fluxai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-13T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Great meeting at Inference & Ops Summit — quick next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the follow-up and the deck — nice to meet you in person.

Tom and I are interested but tight this week. A couple of clarifying items before we lock time:
- Can the pilot demonstrate savings for both streaming (online feature service) and nightly batch runs, or is it focused on one mode?
- We need to loop in security (SOC2 evidence) early — who on your side owns that?

Availability: Thu 2/15 10–11am PT or Mon 2/19 2–3pm PT. Either works for us.

Also attaching the basic scoring trace that shows token distribution (small CSV) — hope that helps.

Samira
Head of Platform
Flux AI

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@fluxai.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@fluxai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T10:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Great meeting at Inference & Ops Summit — quick next steps

Hi Samira / Tom —

Appreciate the quick reply and the trace — that CSV is exactly what we need to size the pilot. Short answers up front:
- Pilot scope: we can run a combined profile run that covers both online (prefix KV cache + low-latency routes) and nightly batch (throughput/quantization). The initial trial will highlight per-token delta across both modes.
- Security contact: cc'ing our Security PM, Jonas Weber, who will handle SOC2 evidence and any audit items. Jonas — could you confirm the typical evidence bundle and turnaround?

Proposed: Thu 2/15, 10:15–11:00am PT for a discovery session. I'll send a calendar invite and a short M.A.P. before the call with responsibilities.

Pre-call asks:
- Any single sample model checkpoints you can share (or s3 path) for the pilot? If not, the token distribution + traces are workable.
- Who will be the primary technical lead on your side? (Tom or someone else)

Thanks — invite coming now.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Post-discovery: draft mutual action plan + pilot checklist

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap + the draft mutual action plan (MAP):

What we covered:
- Confirmed priority: cost reduction for nightly batch scoring (primary) + p95 latency target for online lookups (secondary).
- Token profile: median short prompts for online features; long-tail tokens dominate nightly scoring.
- Constraints: Flux AI needs SOC2 evidence for any customer-managed telemetry; on-prem options possible but prefer Redwood Dedicated.

Draft MAP (high level):
1) Redwood provides a 7-day Dedicated trial starting 2/23 that runs profiler + production-like traffic replay. Deliverables: cost delta report, latency p95 chart, KV cache hit-rate analysis. (Owner: Redwood / Neha)
2) Flux AI provides sample traces and one checkpoint (or s3 path) by 2/20. (Owner: Flux AI / Tom)
3) Security: Jonas to provide SOC2 evidence checklist and a scoped data handling statement by 2/21. (Owner: Jonas)
4) Decision: Flux to decide on pilot expansion or procurement by 3/05.

Attachments: redwood-inference-deck.pdf, MAP-draft (inline in calendar invite).

Action items for you: please confirm the model path availability and whether Tom will be the technical lead. If dates/timing need to shift we can push the start to the following week.

Thanks —
Neha

If helpful, here are two quick options:
- Option A: Start the 7-day trial on 2/23 as planned (preferred)
- Option B: Start 3/01 with an explicit security review window 2/22–2/26

Small asks: can you reply with which option you prefer and confirm who is the technical lead (Tom?) so we can finalize the invite?

If you want to jump on a 10-minute call to unblock, I have two 10-min windows today 1:30pm or 4:00pm PT — or you can pick via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/neha/fluxai-discovery

Thanks — talk soon.
